title: Milk Sad: Libbitcoin Explorer's 32-bit wallet entropy drained ~$900K+ (CVE-2023-39910)
summary: Libbitcoin Explorer's 'bx seed' command generated wallet entropy with a Mersenne Twister PRNG seeded by just 32 bits of system time. Every wallet it ever made was brute-forceable; coordinated theft in July 2023 took $900K+. The historical twin of the 2026 Coldcard flaw: a software PRNG silently standing in for real entropy.

timeline.event: Coordinated on-chain theft drains wallets generated by 'bx seed'.
Distrust research team publishes disclosure as CVE-2023-39910; 'Milk Sad' name comes from the first two BIP39 words of the PRNG's zero-time output.

affected: Any wallet whose seed came from Libbitcoin Explorer 3.x 'bx seed'
notAffected: Wallets with entropy from proper CSPRNGs or physical dice
actions: If you ever generated a wallet with 'bx seed': assume it is compromised; move any remaining funds immediately.
Lesson for everyone else: wallet entropy must come from hardware RNG or physical randomness you can verify — never from a general-purpose PRNG. See our entropy guide.
